description: A registered agent for staff: its role, subagents, tools, skills, permission ceiling and whether organizations enable it.

examples.description: Answers questions about the organization's documents and data catalog from the knowledge base, citing every claim.
examples.name: Knowledge

description.description: What the agent does, as registered (English, from code).

enablement.description: `always`, or `per-organization` when the organization's agent settings decide.

id.description: Agent id (module agents are prefixed by the module id).

name.description: Name the runtime registered (English, from code).

permissions.description: Its ceiling: the permissions its tool calls may ever use (the caller's permissions narrow them).

skills.description: Names of the core skills it loads; skills of enabled modules come on top.

subagents.description: Ids of the agents it may delegate to (the supervisor); the organization's settings narrow them per run.

tools.description: Ids of the tools it has in every organization.

toolsVaryByOrganization.description: True when it also gets tools from the organization's connectors or web opt-ins.
